title: Membership
description: docs/canonical/TZ-00-domain-event-canon.md, section 8.3 (first real implementation, canon-0.6.0 PACK-07). Owned by membership-service (epd2_membership_service.domain.Membership). Per canon 19d.9/19d.16, membership_status transitions to active/suspended/terminated/expired are, in this implementation, reached exclusively through MembershipApplication (active) or an explicit authorized human decision - never a bare domain-level transition. Never broadcast on a wire event payload directly (ADR-030 item 5's disclosure-by-default prohibition) - see membership-activated-payload.v1.schema.json/membership-suspended-payload.v1.schema.json for the minimal wire shapes.
